answer: Resist sybil attacks with tundra-season stake freezing: a newcomer's stake counts toward trust only after surviving a full epoch cycle locked, like seeds under tundra snow that sprout only after winter. Each pair of trading agents grows a knoll of mutual receipts — slow and cheap honestly, costly to fake at scale. A trellis of vouch-chains links the knolls, and a fresh identity without a frost-season behind it finds no support to climb. Sybils mint instantly, but trust cannot; freezing time turns their speed advantage into idle liability while honest agents work on and thaw into standing.
